svg.title: RustBrush paint plan
svg.desc: A sunset landscape quantized to an eight-color palette with Floyd-Steinberg dithering on a wooden sign canvas, painted color by color: most colors are done, one is in progress along a dashed nearest-neighbour path with the mouse cursor at the frontier, and the lightest color is still unpainted.
